description:
About the Position

This Sheffield ECOSOLUTIONS project examines how irrigation wastewater and pesticides jointly influence antimicrobial resistance in agricultural soils and groundwater. The advertised programme provides 45 months of doctoral funding, subject to its selection and eligibility rules. University of Sheffield is seeking candidates for this PhD opportunity focused on Wastewater, Pesticides and AMR at University of Sheffield, UK. Disciplinary scope: Environmental Science. The host institution is in Sheffield, United Kingdom. Funding covers the full cost of participation; financial support is listed as £21,805/year. The stated deadline is 30 November 2026.

Official Project Title

Understanding interactions between wastewater and pesticides on the fate of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in fields

Research Focus and Methods

Compare irrigation sources and use tomato soil mesocosms to study contaminants, microbial diversity and resistance. Test pesticide effects and possible mitigations, including pesticide-degrading bacteria.

Research Training and Development

Includes a three-month secondment with Defra/Fera.

Funding and Duration

Studentship funding and award conditions
ComponentDetails
AwardPhD studentship; selection is competitive
ProgrammeNERC ECOSOLUTIONS
Duration45 months (three years and nine months)
StipendUKRI-rate living stipend. The programme quotes £21,805 per year for 2026/27; the 2027/28 rate is not yet published on the checked funding page.
Tuition and research supportCompetitive NERC ECOSOLUTIONS scholarship covering tuition and a UKRI-rate stipend for 45 months.
Award conditionsA project listing is an invitation to compete for programme funding; international awards are limited.
Stipend amount status£21,805 is the published 2026/27 reference rate. Subsequent academic-year rates and the amount in an individual funding offer should be checked separately.

Eligibility and English Language

Applicant qualifications and funding eligibility
ComponentDetails
Applicant eligibilityUK/Home and international applicants; Sheffield has very limited funded international places.
Academic preparationAt least an upper-second-class honours degree or equivalent in a relevant discipline.
Project interests and skillsLaboratory skills and data analysis or modelling are essential; project 8.
English languageMeet the host university’s English-language admission rules. An approved alternative or exemption may apply; IELTS is not universally mandatory.

About University of Sheffield

University of Sheffield is a public research university in Sheffield, England, and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across engineering, science, medicine, business, humanities and social sciences. Its academic community connects research and teaching with practical challenges in health, technology, sustainability and society.

Official website: https://sheffield.ac.uk/

Application Dates and Location

Deadline, start date and research location

Research locationSheffield, United Kingdom

Contact

  • Email: ellie.harrison@sheffield.ac.uk

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Read the official ECOSOLUTIONS programme page and the linked project advert.
  2. Use the Apply now link on the official programme page and identify the relevant project.
  3. Follow the application form’s current supporting-document instructions; the programme page does not provide a complete document checklist.
  4. Contact the project supervisor for project-specific questions.

Applications are assessed by the programme committee; shortlisted candidates are invited to online interviews. The interview date is not yet specified.
